messages:
ashley: quick async — yesterday: landed the slot-allocator change (roughly 1.2k LOC), added soft-preemption window. Ran microbench against 4k seq and saw ~8-10% p95 regression on small batch sizes. suspect cold KV interactions and allocator oversubscribe.

raj: can you paste the perf dump you ran? which image/commit?

ashley: running on canary @commit 3f9a1b2 (allocator tweak). quick output:```
# bench: conv_batch=8 seq_len=4096 model=redwood-7b
baseline p95=142ms
canary p95=154ms (+8.5%)
kv-hit-rate baseline=0.79 canary=0.73
```:eyes:

maggie: hmm KV hit-rate drop is suspicious. did you change any prefetch params? what about async prefetch backlog size?

ashley: I bumped allocator soft window from 2->3 slots; prefetch unchanged. toggled KV warmup on/off locally — with warmup=on hit-rate goes to ~0.78 and p95 drops to 146ms. so warmup helps but doesn't fully recover.

tomas: tagging CR #2345 for the allocator change — left 2 small nits. ashley, can you link the canary trace? need to eyeball tail latencies.

ashley: trace: https://console.redwood/trace/3f9a1b2/alloc-canary — tail spikes line up with first batch after reshard.

raj: plan: (1) run targeted microburst matrix (batch sizes [1,2,4,8]) with KV warmup and without, (2) try allocator window 2 vs 3 vs 4, (3) collect raw KV evict counts. I can pick up the matrix after lunch.

maggie: blocker: repro on my A100 lab doesn't show regression. env diff maybe e.g. kernel preemption setting or CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES ordering. I'll prod infra to snapshot host config.

ashley: thanks — blocker for me is quota to run the matrix on canary (need 10 reserved slots). asked @infra for temporary bump.

ci-bot: nightly-bench: canary build 3f9a1b2 — bench-rel: small-batch matrix — STATUS: partial-pass (2 failed tests). See https://ci.redwood/builds/3f9a1b2/bench.

raj: ok will review CR today and run matrix. if we can't reproduce on A100, we should try forced cold-KV (evict then run) to make parity.

ashley: today: iterate allocator thresholds, run microburst matrix once infra quota granted, and add a small benchmark to CR. blockers: infra quota + need one more reviewer for perf signoff. :thumbsup:
